messages.title: 🎉 Welcome to ZZZ Mod Hub v1.0.1!
messages.content: We've added a ton of new features, including this Community Feed! Here you will find the latest news, patch notes, and mods personally recommended by the developer.

messages.title: 💡 Pro Tip: Drag & Drop
messages.content: Did you know you can drag and drop .zip or .rar mod archives directly into the app to install them instantly? Try it out!

messages.title: 👾 Join our Discord
messages.content: Need help with modding or want to share your favorite creations? Join our community Discord to talk with other modders.

messages.title: 📊 What should we mod next?
messages.content: Vote for the next character you want to see a mod for on GameBanana!
